q: 订单金额最高的前3个会员是谁？
sql: SELECT t_a.f_name, SUM(t_b.f_amount) AS total_amount FROM t_a JOIN t_b ON t_a.id = t_b.f_member_id GROUP BY t_a.id, t_a.f_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 3;

q: 销量最高的商品是哪个？
sql: SELECT t_d.f_title, SUM(t_c.f_qty) FROM t_c JOIN t_d ON t_c.f_product_id = t_d.id GROUP BY t_d.id ORDER BY SUM(t_c.f_qty) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT t_e.f_label, COUNT(t_d.id) FROM t_e JOIN t_d ON t_e.id = t_d.f_category_id GROUP BY t_e.id ORDER BY COUNT(t_d.id) DESC LIMIT 1;
